NewsArticle.Title: Mileth Travel Improvements
NewsArticle.Content:
Mundanes construct bridges between the Inn and the Alchemist, the Fae Priestess and the Crypt Entrance. The Bridge and the gate near the Old Temple are widened.
Passage ways are made between the two higglers and the main road and the baker, making banking and reaching the merchant's quarter more convenient. Passage by the Fae Priestess and other shops were also cleared for more convenient travel.
The road outside of Mileth is widened so that no banished or exiled persons can block more than a fraction of the road.
In Rucesion a second dock is built which also prevents someone banished or exiled from Rucesion from blocking Rucesion travel.
